stem: Which excerpt from the Declaration of Independence best explains why colonists were unhappy about their lack of representation in the British parliament?

options.label: A
options.text: “He has refused to pass other Laws for the accommodation of large districts of people.”

options.label: B
options.text: “For imposing Taxes on us without our Consent.”

options.label: C
options.text: “He has refused his Assent to Laws, the most wholesome and necessary for the public good.”

options.label: D
options.text: “For transporting us beyond Seas to be tried for pretended offences.”
